protocol.name: algorithm-stability-2026-10-16
protocol.authorization: User requested completion of the last indicator cell, diagnosis of deterioration, and a different model if supported by the diagnosis. User then proposed RecurrentPPO; prepare it as a third arm to distinguish standard PPO from LSTM memory.
protocol.selection: Equal-weight mean validation net return; retain best and post-update final weights for every seed.
protocol.controls: Same immutable basic-input dataset, train through 2020, validate 2021-2023, original net-log-equity reward, simulator, 64x64 hidden-layer widths, learning rate and discount; existing algorithm-specific defaults. Fresh SAC controls and PPO runs share one learning-source/dependency identity. PPO and RecurrentPPO rollout 1000, batch 50, 10 epochs as in prior remote PPO research. No KL/reward/sampling tuning.
protocol.why_fresh_controls: New diagnostic logging; one uninterrupted 100k learn call with a post-update endpoint. Earlier SAC study segmented learning at 50k/100k and historical model study mixed CPU/CUDA. Do not treat those as identical new trajectories.
protocol.hypothesis: On-policy PPO with clipped updates may retain validation performance better than SAC replay-based updates. Prior basic-input 50k PPO had lower seed variability than SAC; this does not establish superiority. RecurrentPPO tests whether causal sequence memory adds value beyond standard PPO; its LSTM adds parameters, so it is not a parameter-count-matched proof of memory alone.
protocol.diagnosis_limits: Saved-path comparisons identify directional/exposure shifts and cost changes, not a proven causal mechanism. Low critic loss or falling entropy alone does not demonstrate overfitting.
protocol.retired_test: 2024 through September 2026 remains retired; no new final-test evaluation or orders.
protocol.stopping: Finish these nine fixed cells only, unless user stop or budget/deadline/metering/unrecoverable failure. No automatic restart after budget stop. No search expansion based on outcomes.
protocol.start_after: All nine indicator cells retrieved, verified, published, and their owned sessions stopped; clean the indicator temporary duplicates first.

recurrent_config.inference_state: Carry hidden/cell state only within a symbol episode; reset at every episode boundary; zero state initially; no warmup across data splits.

protocol.memory_comparison: Apply the same paired gate to recurrent_ppo versus standard ppo, in addition to each candidate versus SAC. No superiority claim from recurrent-versus-SAC alone.

execution.hardware: CPU fixed for this matched experiment; generic fleet supports validated CPU/GPU plans
execution.lower_credit_preflight: Three concurrent CPU single-algorithm smoke jobs: SAC 1024, PPO 512, RecurrentPPO 512; complete owned cleanup before research allocation
execution.budget: Single account-level fleet charge plus preserved historical serial attempts; shared 150-unit ceiling, teardown by 130, 360-second aggregate cleanup projection; per-allocation two-hour deadline

interpretation: Validation-selected policies and final checkpoints, equal means of separate stock episodes. Recurrent models add capacity; their effect is not a parameter-count-matched proof of memory alone. No independent test performance claim.
